purpose: Cross-skill regression assertions for shared protocol consistency.

assertions.rule: SOURCE enum includes UNKNOWN and specialists must not guess SOURCE.
Brief final handoff must support Creative Exploration Specialist / Product Innovation Specialist / Other and must preserve HOLD.
Creative and Product formal cases require source audit fields and permit UNVERIFIED without promoting to strong evidence.
Creative and Product Selection Gate explicitly allow KEEP NONE.
Product Innovation encodes INNOVATION REOPEN and BRIEF REOPEN as separate failure branches.
Cross-workstream field name is CROSS-WORKSTREAM SIGNALS; legacy CREATIVE SIGNAL / PRODUCT INNOVATION SIGNAL must not be used as shared field names.
Proposal may not infer SOURCE, may not equate logic coherence with SUPPORTED, and may not declare R&D/Pilot readiness without feasibility constraints.
Project Hub provides a no-file-write fallback through PROJECT STATE BLOCK and checks minimum handoff integrity.

Proposal Development is routed and described as developing an existing Strategy / Idea / Innovation Direction into a complete proposal file; client decision is a diagnostic consideration, not the product definition.

Creative formal research cases (not speculative Idea Seeds) require authentic visual and traceable SOURCE / VISUAL SOURCE links; incomplete cases remain TO SOURCE / BACKUP, with no fictitious proof. The requirement does not force a case study before ideation.

Creative may develop an already selected Idea directly; Concept Development evaluates only relevant creative, audience, brand and execution conditions. It must not require post-hoc Human Insight / Creative Spark or a long-term Concept Platform for a standalone film or activation, and IMC is not used to rescue a weak idea.

Project Hub is the single source of VERSION / UPDATE PROTOCOL: GitHub main is canonical, freshness check is triggered when explicitly requested, source is unknown, or last known check exceeds 7 days; updates are never silently applied; all four Specialists inherit this rule rather than redefining it; true weekly polling requires external automation.

Brand-strategy Briefs may produce a Brand Logic Bridge from Human Spark through Brand Belief, Brand Role, Product/Offering Truth, Competitive Contrast and Positioning Difference; Human Spark is evidence-bounded synthesis, not fabricated verbatim consumer language.

Creative preserves upstream Human Spark, Human Insight and Creative Spark as evidence-tagged optional references. They do not become mandatory steps or a logical proof chain for Idea generation. Creative may advance conditionally without falsely marking AI recommendations SELECTED.

Brief, Creative, Product Innovation and Proposal user-facing language follows shared LANGUAGE_CONTROL: natural Chinese, concrete behavior over abstract consulting language, precise English terms such as tension when clearer, and explicit uncertainty instead of polished AI vagueness.

Product Innovation uses Spark Calibration for user feedback rather than overloading Human Spark, and keeps evidence rigor while presenting innovation directions first in human terms: who wants it, what product changes, and what experience becomes different.

SELECTED is reserved for explicit human/team/client selection or reliable upstream inheritance. AI may recommend and conditionally continue through CURRENT BEST JUDGMENT, but AI preference, 'continue', relative superiority, or evidence strength must never be rewritten as SELECTED.

Proposal evidence status must survive rewriting into Storyline, titles and file-ready copy: CONFIRMED/SUPPORTED/WORKING HYPOTHESIS/OPEN require matching language strength, and PPT brevity must not convert a hypothesis into fact.
Product Innovation runtime handoff must use CROSS-WORKSTREAM SIGNALS and must not emit legacy CREATIVE SIGNAL or PRODUCT INNOVATION SIGNAL field names.
Brief has opt-in Growth Diagnosis with DATA CONTRACT; RFR, buyer-mix, MAT/YTD and causality caveats remain separate.
Product Innovation supports category-derived Product Deconstruction, Consumer Value Expansion, OPTION INTEGRITY, regulated claim preflight and controlled test design; no examples hard-coded.
Hub differentiates FULL EXPLORE, LOCAL DEEPEN and DIRECT REVIEW without adding a fifth Specialist or changing Selection Authority.
Proposal evidence trace and artifact QA distinguish full-slide screenshots from editable originals and include visual render/Chinese typography checks.

Creative defaults to IDEA FIRST from the original problem and factual materials, while case Inspiration Search and independent Research Atlas remain opt-in / task-triggered. Case studies are not a mandatory gate to Ideas; actual Research Atlas / Casebook delivery still requires credible cases, media, source and offline artifact QA.

Product Innovation checks the alignment of consumer promise, experienced benefit, product evidence and feasibility at Selection without creating a fourth round; distinguish missing proof from proven impossibility and preserve user Selection Authority.

Brief Discovery checks original definitions and applicability of externally named frameworks and terminology, distinguishes client usage from external source meaning, and does not invent an equivalent theory or treat verified definition as proof of business applicability.

Creative inherits evidence-backed competitor and offering advantage when it matters for an Idea, researches only decisive gaps, and does not invent superiority or reopen Brief by default. Creative mechanisms may produce narrative, attention, feeling and memory without mandatory interaction, UGC or activation; Selection evaluates task-specific audience effort.

Creative Open Leap starts from the same real Brief, assets, constraints and source-bounded facts, generates concrete distinct ideas before explanatory rationalization, First Cuts for surprise/problem fit/brand belonging, tests retained ideas afterward, and re-generates when judged generic instead of post-hoc justifying the original.

Project Hub Creative default stop and Creative → Proposal handoff are idea-first; insights and Sparks are optional, source-tagged references, not required shared handoff fields. Selection remains human-controlled; other Specialists keep their professional round structure.
